event.title: Let's Save Each Other: Community and Solidarity Through Art & Tech
event.description:
3-month art & tech winter residency in Berlin-Mitte or online. Makerspace, mentorship, showcases. No experience needed. 9 Nov–31 Jan

For more information, check your website : https://www.schoolofma.org/programs/p/fall2026-creating-community-solidarity-thru-art-tech

We are inviting thoughtful, creative humans (like you!) in Berlin and beyond to come together for ****the next three months both on- and off- line to learn, play, think, and create together.**** Come explore art, tech, design, political inquiry and human connection on zoom, or in our makerspace, and studio on the top floor of the historic ACUD Kunsthaus, the last surviving independent art and culture space from the 1990 reunification era in Berlin-Mitte.

This is the program we’ve been dreaming of for years! We’re opening our doors and ****inviting creative emerging artists, humans with innovative and intelligent minds, and anyone who is curious to come explore new topics****, develop and expand your practice, and learn and teach things you’ve only dreamed of learning and teaching, as you wrestle out the courage to begin something new.

We’ll support you in these endeavors while encouraging introspection, curiosity, hands-on exploration, and the enthusiasm and confidence to say something with your work. ****No prior tech experience necessary.****

This is an open-ended program, more of an indoor winter camp for adults interested in exploration and creative life changes. Some afternoons there'll be a handful of people quietly (or not so quietly) working on projects; on potluck nights and some eves, the space may be fully alive. Come as often as you can!

#### what we provide

### In Berlin

-   Our studio and makerspace located at ACUD in Berlin, Mitte, will be open on weekdays from 13:00 to 20:00 and on weekends from 10:00 to 20:00. On special event nights, we'll stay open until 23:00 (all times are Berlin time)
-   Opportunities to run a talk, workshop or mini-class on something you know
-   Weekly community potlucks
-   Classrooms you can reserve for knowledge exchange
-   Onsite materials and tools: 3D printers, electronics, hand tools, a sewing machine, cameras, recorders and more
-   Mentorship and support

### Online

-   The ability to schedule talks, workshops and other events on Zoom
-   An online forum for exchanging ideas, sharing knowledge, and group discussions
-   A mentor, assigned once the program begins, available for one-on-one check-ins if you feel stuck
-   If you're able to come to Berlin at some point during the three months, you can join in person at no extra cost

### For everyone

-   Opportunities to exhibit your work IRL (see details below)
-   Weekly prompts to inspire your creative output and lead you towards self-reflection and discovery, plus regular interactions with others doing the same
-   Guest speakers on topics relating to art, technology, and society, with questions, interaction and discussion following, open to everyone in the program
-   A dedicated online forum to share work and connect with the whole group

During this three-month program, participants will have the opportunity to showcase work in two key moments:

-   ****6\. December****: A visual showcase in collaboration with Berlin School of Sound taking place at Studio dB Berlin.
-   ****January 2027:**** A group exhibition in our Make-Believe Studio during transmediale Vorspiel (end of month, date tbd)

We are offering a limited number of reduced fee solidarity tickets for this program ****for those facing financial hardships****. These allow participants to pay a reduced fee and are reserved for women, BIPOC, and LGBTQ+ who otherwise would be unable to attend.

**All the information is here. You can also buy tickets directly from our website, and apply for a solidarity ticket there.** https://www.schoolofma.org/programs/p/fall2026-creating-community-solidarity-thru-art-tech

event.title: PLAY – Creative Gaming Festival 2026
event.description:
PLAY – Creative Gaming Festival 2026 returns to Hamburg from 18–21 November 2026, transforming the URBANEO Young Architecture Center into a vibrant hub for digital creativity. The festival celebrates the intersection of media art, education, and gaming culture, offering four days of inspiring workshops, interactive exhibitions, talks, and hands‑on activities. With its 2026 theme “Hey, listen! – Music & Emotion,” PLAY explores how sound, storytelling, and emotional expression shape the way we experience games. 

As the world’s first festival to unite media art, discourse, and education with digital games, PLAY invites visitors to invent, build, tinker, program, dance, and discuss. The Creative Gaming Awards highlight innovative works that encourage playful experimentation and creative interaction. Returning to the URBANEO after a successful previous edition, the festival offers an inspiring venue for exhibitions, performances, and community‑driven experiences that celebrate the full spectrum of creative gaming culture. 

Please see event site for ticket prices.

[REGISTER](https://www.playfestival.de/en)

event.title: AI Builders × commIT | Hack Day Berlin 2026
event.description:
Build something useful with AI. Ship a prototype. Demo it live!

Join AI Builders and commIT in Berlin for a full day of building with AI. Bring an idea, meet collaborators, and turn a promising concept into a working prototype alongside fellow builders.

Whether you’re an experienced developer, an AI enthusiast, a designer, a founder, or someone who wants to explore what’s possible with AI, this is a chance to learn by building. Come with a team or arrive solo and find people to build with!

## // FOR WHO

- ✅ Developers, product people, data enthusiasts, ML engineers and founders
- ✅ Anyone interested in building useful things with AI
- ✅ AI builders exploring applications, agents, workflows and automation
- ✅ Solo participants and existing teams of up to 4 people
- ⚠️ Basic familiarity with AI tools or LLM concepts is helpful, but curiosity and a willingness to build matter most!

## // FORMAT

🚀 Open AI Hackathon choose a problem and build an AI-powered solution
💡 Idea Pitches & Team Matching bring your own idea or find collaborators on the day
💻 Hands-on Build Sprint prototype, test and iterate with fellow builders
🎤 Live Demos & Judging show what you built and share your approach
🏆 Awards details to be announced once confirmed
🍕 Pizza & Drinks refuel after the build sprint
🤝 Evening Networking connect with builders, exchange ideas and keep the conversations going until 22:00
Team size: 1–4 people. Solo participants are welcome and can join a team during matching.

## // FORMAT

What to expect

- A focused day of hands-on AI building
- Short idea pitches and team matching
- Dedicated time to prototype and iterate
- Opportunities to meet other AI builders and exchange ideas
- Live project demos and judging
- Pizza and drinks
- An informal networking session to connect with fellow builders and continue conversations into the evening

Come with an idea or an open mind. You don’t need a finished project to take part—just curiosity, a willingness to build, and an idea of what you’d like to explore.

**// AGENDA**

09:45 **👋** **Doors Open**

10:00 **📋** **Welcome & Challenges**

10:20 **🤝** **Pitching & Team Matching**

10:40 **🚀** **Hack Session (+ optional workshop)**

11:00 **🚀** **Hack Session Begins**

12:30 **🌯** **Lunch Break**

13:00 **🚀** **Hack Session**

15:30 **🏆** **Feature Freeze & Demo Prep**

16:00 **🏆** **Live Demos**

17:00 **🏆** **Judging & Community Networking**

17:30 **🏆** **Awards & Closing Remarks**

18:00 **🤝** **Pizza, Drinks & Open Networking**

22:00 **💻** **Event Ends**

## // FAQ

- **New question?**
- **What is AI Builders?** A self-organizing nonprofit community of 13,500+ AI nerds 🤓. We're building a democratic AI platform, to make our community completely co-owned and co-governed by you (yes, all attendees).
- **Will it be recorded?** Yes, some sessions are streamed live and recorded. By attending, you consent to being photographed and filmed. Let us know if you don't want to be on camera.
- **I'm not technical. Can I come?** Yes, but to actually enjoy the meetup we recommend understanding basic LLM concepts: Agents, Embeddings, RAG, MCPs, Inference, Structured Output, Finetuning, APIs, Reinforcement Learning. Not sure what those mean? Ask any chatbot — that's literally what they're for.
- **Can I get a free ticket? Can I volunteer?** Money should never be the reason not to join. If you need a sponsored ticket, or want to help out by arriving 1.5h early to set up, message [Martin](https://aibuilders.club/whatsapp-martink).
- **Can I demo, give a talk, or just help out?** Message [Martin](https://aibuilders.club/whatsapp-martink) if you want to shine ✨ on stage and grow your network — community demos are 10 minutes, builder demos are 15-20 minutes.
- **What time does the hackday start?** The hackday starts at 10:00 on Friday, 20 November.
- **Do I need to form a team in advance?** No! We'll have team formation at the beginning. You can also join solo.
- **What should I bring?** Bring your laptop, charger, and any APIs/tools you want to use.
- **How do I submit my project?** Submit via the hackday dashboard. Include a demo video and GitHub link.

## // What to bring

- Your laptop and charger
- An idea you’d like to explore or a willingness to join someone else’s
- Any tools or accounts you expect to use for building

*Please register early, as we expect the event to reach full capacity!* If all spots are taken, we strongly encourage you to join the waitlist. Places may open up, and being on the list increases your chances of securing a spot—so don’t let a full registration discourage you from signing up!

Registering also helps the organizers plan ahead. Further details about judging criteria, submissions, and any confirmed sponsor contributions will be shared ahead of the event.

## // VENUE & SPONSORS

With ImmoScout24 & Nebius.
Venue: ImmoScout24
Invalidenstraße 65, 10557 Berlin, Germany

We look forward to hanging out with you!
Thanks to our friends for hosting us in their beautiful space.
This wouldn't be possible without our local hosts and organizers: [Martin Kaiser](https://linkedin.com/in/martingkaiser), [Lingkesh Vijayakumar](https://linkedin.com/in/lingkesh-vijayakumar-108021200), [Andrei Marcut](https://linkedin.com/in/amarcut), [Simon Schreiner](https://linkedin.com/in/simon-schreiner-86050b2b8) and [Vitalina Alipova](https://linkedin.com/in/vitalina-alipova).

event.title: Beyond Coding: Building with AI
event.description:
**EVENT AGENDA**
17:00 – Arrival & Socializing
17:15 – Welcome to Our First Official Meetup!
17:20 – **Open Discussion & Audience Q&A**
Afterwards - Networking and food

Looking forward to seeing you 👋🏻
**[Melody](https://www.linkedin.com/in/melodyegwuchukwu/)** & **[Emad](https://www.linkedin.com/in/emad-bawah-a6b59b1bb/).**

\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-
**The Open Discussion**↓

When writing code becomes easier, what becomes more important?

Join us for an open conversation about what this shift means for students and professionals. We’ll explore how the developer’s role is changing, where AI agents can help, and why understanding the applications we build still matters.

For students, we’ll discuss the foundations worth learning, how to demonstrate your skills in an AI-assisted project, and how cloud knowledge can support your first steps into tech. For professionals, we’ll explore how to evaluate AI-generated work, decide what to delegate, and keep quality, security, and maintainability in view.

We’ll also connect the conversation to AWS: what does it take to move from generated code to an application that runs reliably in the cloud?
Bring your questions, experiments, and lessons learned. Whether you’re building your first project or maintaining production systems, your perspective belongs in the conversation.

**Our first official meetup** 🎉
This event marks the official launch of AWS User Group Bochum! Melody Egwuchukwu will introduce the community, share its vision, and unveil our new logo.

Whether you’re searching for your first internship, building applications professionally, or simply curious about AI and AWS, come meet others who are learning, building, and asking similar questions. You’ll also have the chance to share ideas for future meetups and help shape the community from the beginning.

**Speakers**
**Md. Mostafa Al Mahmud** is a Senior Software Engineer at Cogwheel Marketing & Analytics. He has presented on generative AI, AWS, and building cloud-based AI applications, bringing a practical perspective to conversations about technology and the future of work.

**Emad Bawah** is a Senior Consultant at Adesso SE with a focus on AWS, generative AI, and agentic AI.
He brings a robust skill set from his role in building smarter AI agents and experience interfacing with Clients and building AI solutions.

\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-
**Please note:**
At the event, photos and videos will be taken by our hosts, which would be published on our Social Pages.

event.title: Friday Making Hours
event.description:
Whatever you want to make, we try to make it possible together! Come check out the CoMakingSpace :-)

During this weekly meetup, volunteers offer guidance and supervision for members as well as tours for those who are interested in our community workshop! Besides Raspberry Pi and other electronics projects, you could try your hand at woodworking, metalworking, 3D printing, CNC routing or laser cutting, for example.
Machine introductions are not always possible on short notice, especially when it's a busy evening - best arrange yourself with a tutor in advance!

• Wichtig zu wissen
[membership options](https://comakingspace.org/mach_mit/join_us.html) to work on your own projects // *[Mitgliedschaft](https://comakingspace.org/mach_mit/index.html) um selbst zu werkeln*
